title: Private Antelope Island State Park Tour
blurb:
Experience Antelope Island and the Great Salt Lake on a private wildlife safari reserved exclusively for your group.

Newly offered on Viator after previously being bookable only through our website, this Safari Utah experience comes from the same team behind our top-rated Great Salt Lake Safari - Discover Antelope Island.

Led by a Utah local and former African safari guide, this 4-hour tour combines wildlife, scenery, birding, photography, ecology, and local history with the freedom to shape the experience around your interests.

Explore rugged hills, grasslands, shoreline, and salt-flat views while searching for bison, pronghorn, mule deer, and birdlife.

Your group only: Enjoy a more intimate experience with no other travelers.

More flexibility: Spend extra time with wildlife, photography, birding, viewpoints, or a short Buffalo Point hike if time, conditions, and interests allow.

Ideal for couples, families, photographers, birders, solo travelers, and special occasions.
